_doc: AGENT-INTEROP-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): which agent-interoperability standards the public site implements, declines or has pending, with source and date read. Checked by `python3 -m foundation agentstd --check`; consumed by tests/foundation/test_agentstd.py and site/agentic.js.
marker_text: AGENT-CONSUMPTION: code is written to be read by agents as well as run. Public surfaces serve Link headers, llms.txt, an OpenAPI description, an API catalog, an MCP server card and a read-only MCP server (site/agentic.js); every endpoint has a stable operationId, errors are JSON with a machine-readable code, and no behaviour is explained only in prose. Standards and their status: doctrine/agent-standards.json (`python3 -m foundation agentstd --check`).

standards.what: Accept: text/markdown (preferred over text/html) returns the page as Markdown with Vary: Accept and x-markdown-tokens
RFC 8288 Link headers on HTML responses pointing to llms.txt, the OpenAPI description, the API catalog and the sitemap
robots.txt declares Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
llms.txt in the llmstxt.org shape: H1, blockquote summary, H2 file lists, an Optional section
OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public API at /openapi.json
Read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC) at /mcp; no write tool is exposed
Server card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. The card shape is a draft in Cloudflare's readiness check, not a ratified specification

standards.reason: No A2A endpoint exists to describe; publishing a card without one would advertise a capability that is not built

standards.what: robots.txt names AI crawlers: search and user agents allowed, training-only crawlers disallowed, matching the Content-Signal
navigator.modelContext tools (status, agents, work, brief) on every page, read-only, calling the public /api/v1
RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata and RFC 8414 server discovery
standards.reason: no OAuth authorization server exists: reads are public and /api/v1/intake uses a bearer key; publishing OAuth metadata would be false

standards.what: Ultrastable's own outbound agents (scout, rnd, outreach resolver) sign requests (HTTP Message Signatures) and publish /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory
standards.trigger: a signing key is bound to the tick Worker as a secret

standards.what: x402, Universal Commerce Protocol, Agentic Commerce Protocol (non-scoring commerce checks)
standards.reason: VISION: Ultrastable does not sell online; no checkout to expose
